parameters.description:
`msg-to-humhub` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your HumHub instance — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own HumHub instances — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional HumHub instances bound per enrollment.

This service posts into a space on your own HumHub instance (the REST API module must be installed and active — see marketplace.humhub.com/module/rest). Navigate to the target space and note its numeric ID from the trailing number in the space's URL, or list your spaces via GET /api/v1/space on your instance's REST API, then set that ID as HUMHUB_CONTAINER_ID.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"data":{"message":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment HumHub destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your HumHub post API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own HumHub instance by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's HUMHUB_BASE_URL value (same format as HUMHUB_BASE_URL)

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's HUMHUB_BASIC value (same format as HUMHUB_BASIC)

container_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's HumHub container ID
